Title: Principal AI Solutions Lead
Description: Who are we? Auction Technology Group (ATG) is transforming the multi-billion-dollar global auction industry. Our platforms connect thousands of auction houses with buyers in over 170 countries, powering more than $15 billion in annual sales. Through innovative online auction technologies, we help auctioneers expand their reach, boost efficiency, and maximize value—while giving bidders unrivaled access to rare and specialized items. As a publicly traded company, ATG has scaled from $18 million to $170 million in revenue, with sustained growth beyond the pandemic. We're modernizing one of the last industries to fully go digital—building a global, category-defining business in the process. Who are we looking for? As our Applied AI Lead, you’ll be the person who makes AI real at ATG — not as a strategy deck, but as working tools people use every day. This is a senior individual contributor role: you’ll build alongside the team, and you’ll set the standards, governance, and direction for how the organization builds and adopts AI. Roughly half your time is hands-on delivery. You’ll size opportunities, design future-state flows, document requirements, build solutions using AI-assisted development tools, and deploy them across Operations, Finance, and HR. This matters to us: you can’t set credible standards for AI-built systems if you aren’t living under them yourself. The other half is scope only you will carry. You’ll define how these systems are governed — who can build what, how tools are reviewed, who owns them after launch, and how we retire what no longer earns its place. You’ll partner with Legal and IT on the security and data-privacy questions that AI-built tools raise. You’ll lead adoption across the organization, including running internal build events that get colleagues outside this team creating their own solutions. And you’ll own the implementation of major AI platforms, most immediately our AI-powered customer support system: a significant cross-functional program spanning integration, change management, and rollout. This role delivers against ATG’s Hands-Off Keyboard (HOK) mandate: our commitment to taking manual work out of the business. You won’t have direct reports, but you will set the bar for how ATG builds with AI, and you’ll mentor the Automation Associate on this team. Key Responsibilities Hands-On Delivery Build and deploy automations yourself. You’ll size opportunities, design the future-state flow, document requirements, and ship working solutions using AI-assisted development tools — keeping a steady cadence of delivered projects alongside the program work below. Maintenance & Support Keep the portfolio running. You’ll carry your share of the support load for deployed tools and set how the team handles it. You’ll also make the call on when a tool should be rebuilt, absorbed into a core system, or retired. AI Support Platform Implementation Own the end-to-end implementation of ATG’s AI-powered customer support system: integration planning, cross-functional coordination, change management, and rollout across our marketplace brands. This is a major program and one of the single largest opportunities in front of us. Governance & Standards Define how AI-built systems are governed at ATG including what gets built and by whom, how tools are reviewed and documented, who owns them after launch, and how they’re maintained or retired. Legal, IT & Security Partnership Work with Legal and IT on how AI tools handle company and customer data, what’s permitted, and what safeguards are required. You’ll translate between the technical reality and the risk questions leadership needs answered. Organizational Enablement Lead AI adoption beyond this team across all ATG employees. Provide training, internal hackathons and build events, office hours, and practical support that turns curious colleagues into capable builders. Measurement & Reporting Own the portfolio view of what we’re delivering: usage, adoption, and savings realized against savings projected. Report it credibly to senior leadership, including where projects underperform and what we’re doing about it. Key Requirements Who are you? You’ve built and shipped internal tools or automations that provide value and that people use today. You’ve led a significant cross-functional implementation or platform rollout end to end: stakeholder alignment, change management, go-live. Fluent with AI-assisted development and low-code tools, and current on how fast the space is moving. Pragmatic about what these tools do well and clear-eyed about where they don’t belong. You’ve handled governance, security, or data-privacy questions inside a real organization, and you can hold a productive conversation with Legal and IT rather than an adversarial one. Strong commercial instincts: you can size a prize, defend an estimate, and tell leadership when something isn’t worth doing. Credible with senior stakeholders and comfortable influencing without authority. You’ll lead a lot of people who don’t report to you. An appetite for teaching and raising other people’s capability. A meaningful part of this job is making colleagues better at building. Bonus: experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, or a multi-brand operating environment; exposure to customer support platforms or contact center technology.

Title: Senior Software Engineer
Description: ABOUT EARNIN As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and excited to bring on world-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey. EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products. As a company, we are becoming AI-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. When in doubt, ask your recruiter or interviewer directly. POSITION SUMMARY Join our DevelSoper Experience team to design and ship AI-native tooling and agentic workflows that meaningfully accelerate the way EarnIn engineers build, ship, and operate software, and help set a new bar for what engineering productivity looks like. This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. WHAT YOU'LL DO Draw on firsthand experience with the friction, toil, and frustrations that slow engineering teams down and use that empathy to build tools and automation that actually solve the right problems. Drive the design, development, and implementation of tools, systems, and processes that accelerate engineering velocity, reduce manual effort, and raise the quality bar for software delivery. Use the latest AI capabilities LLM APIs, agentic workflows, MCP patterns, and AI-assisted development environments to fundamentally rethink what a high-productivity engineering team looks like. Architect and operate multi-step agentic systems with well-defined inputs, outputs, validation checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop guardrails that run reliably at scale. Embed AI-assisted capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows to improve build reliability, code quality feedback loops, and developer toil reduction. Guide and advise product engineering teams on best practices for building observable, scalable systems acting as a force multiplier across the org, not just within DevX. Partner directly with engineering teams to identify high-friction workflows, translate them into structured AI-assisted automation, and measure impact against defined success metrics. Instrument AI-powered features with end-to-end logging, monitoring, evaluation, and their lifecycle from pilot through iteration or retirement. Document patterns, usage guidance, and best practices so proven workflows can be consistently adopted and extended across the org. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building infrastructure or internal tooling for developer teams; fluency in Python or Go. Firsthand experience with the tools, workflows, and pain points of software engineering teams; you've felt the friction yourself and know how to fix it. Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic or LLM-powered systems in production, including practical familiarity with MCP patterns, tool-augmented workflows, or multi-step agent architectures. Some experience integrating with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent) and an understanding of tradeoffs around context management, latency, cost, and safety. Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms, including building custom workflows, reusable actions, or automation that operates on code or pull requests. Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent); treat these as core to how you work, not a nice-to-have. Ability to define meaningful metrics for AI-assisted tooling and run time-bound experiments to validate impact. Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable advising and influencing partner engineering teams in a distributed environment.
